services.app_desc: Run secure elections in minutes with our easy-to-use app. Perfect for associations, towns, professional bodies, cooperatives, or organizations that need simple, secure, and accessible voting without technical complexity.
services.explanation: Whether you need a quick vote, seamless developer integration, or a fully tailored governance solution, Vocdoni has you covered. Trusted by organizations worldwide for many use cases, including AGMs, referendums, elections, and participatory budgets.
services.projects_desc: For governments, enterprises, and large organizations that need tailored governance systems, we provide end-to-end solutions with expert support and dedicated infrastructure.
services.sdk_desc: Our Software Development Kit lets you seamlessly integrate Vocdoni's secure voting infrastructure into your own platforms.

technology.accessible_desc: Anyone, anywhere, from any device can take part. Designed for inclusivity, Vocdoni removes barriers so every voice can be heard, without technical or geographical limitations.
technology.efficient_desc: From a small cooperative to a national election, Vocdoni scales seamlessly. It's fast, cost-effective, and sustainable, cutting costs and environmental impact compared to traditional methods.
technology.headline: Technology
technology.secure_desc: Advanced cryptography and zero-knowledge proofs keep every vote secret while keeping results fully verifiable. Voters remain anonymous, yet the election outcome is beyond doubt.
technology.transparent_desc: Every process is transparent and fully auditable. From ballot creation to vote counting, anyone can verify the integrity of the election, eliminating the need for blind trust in intermediaries.
technology.vision: Our vision is simple: a world where collective decision–making can happen anywhere, from any device, transparently and securely. No intermediaries, no barriers.
technology.why_description: Because fair, accessible governance should be a right, not a luxury.
